title: Issi ben Yaakov
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yalkut, Mishpatim, at remez 324 in Hyman’s print (the supplied transcription has שכר). Hyman calls this a scribal error, for the source is the Mekhilta, Mishpatim, Massekhta deNezikin, chapter 4, where it is Issi ben Akiva. He says that the author of Maskil LeEitan needlessly faulted our master, the author of Seder HaDorot, over this.

notes.text: The supplied Yalkut numeral is שכר and is retained literally rather than converted to an unsupported 320. The saved Torat Emet Yalkut 320 paragraph concerns the Hebrew maidservant and does not supply the cited Issi passage; the correct locator remains unresolved. Maskil LeEitan is a work title, not the name LeEitan with “learned” as a separate epithet. The author’s personal identity and the source letters are not established here.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. I, p. 153) has שכד, 324. The matching passage in the Torat Emet Yalkut, Mishpatim 324, names Issi ben Yaakov in the interpretation of “I shall make a place for you” (Exodus 21:13). The parallel in Mekhilta deRabbi Yishmael, Nezikin 4:16, names Issi ben Akiva. This comparison establishes a difference in the transmitted name. The copyist explanation and the criticism of Maskil LeEitan remain Hyman’s, and the exact note he criticized was not collated.
